title: Asset Identity Map
description: Entity model for the CAMARA private-asset profile. An asset is a tracked thing (UWB tag, tool, pallet, forklift), NOT a cellular subscriber: it has no MSISDN/IMSI/NAI. The gateway resolves a CAMARA `device.assetId` to one of these entries and routes to the positioning source by `positioning_id`. Authored over the network via GET/PUT /assets on the camara-gateway (PVC-backed, mirrors the engine's GET/PUT /blueprint); never a mounted file at runtime. Tier-1 (sensitive: org/asset inventory) - gitignored in dev, PVC + dashboard in prod. Full resolution chain (assetId -> positioning_id -> adapter -> vendor): see docs/integrating-a-vendor-rest-api.md.

version.description: Asset Identity Map schema version. Pinned in schema/VERSION.

asset_id.description: First-class CAMARA identifier (device.assetId). A business id chosen by the enterprise (e.g. pkg-4471, forklift-7). NOT a phone number.

positioning_id.description: Internal id the positioning engine routes on (engine /position/{positioning_id}). Joins to an adapter via the engine's adapter registry / DEVICE_MAP.

kind.description: Asset class. Surfaced as profile `kind` so consumers can reason about the entity type.

source.description: Positioning modality / adapter. Surfaced as profile `source` (a UWB fix is trusted differently from a WiFi fix at the same radius).

org.description: Tenant. The gateway joins this against the token `org` claim (2-legged enterprise auth) so a consumer sees only its tenant's assets.

simulated.description: True when wired to a synthetic/demo source (synthetic-adapter, mock-vendor). UIs show a synthetic badge.
